## Review Depth And Authority

Every commit in the complete range received an explicit disposition after subject, path, statistics, surrounding-commit, dependency, workflow, migration, release, focused-patch, and current Scient seam inspection. Focused patch review concentrated on user-visible candidates and protected Git, provider, session, storage, credential, packaging, updater, release, telemetry, and recovery lanes.

This is research evidence, not proof that donor code executed correctly in Scient. T3 remains a disposable fetch-only reference donor with push disabled. The accepted targeted-review boundary remains `bf76535f`; this scheduled scan creates no maintained checkpoint or integration base.

No donor or Scient UI was rendered. No computer use, browser automation, screenshots, geometry checks, visual tests, or manual UI acceptance were performed.
